name: xray-cloud
description: Manage Xray Cloud tests, test sets, plans, executions and runs from Claude Code through a zero-install Python MCP server.

xray_client_id.title: Xray client ID
xray_client_id.description: Xray Cloud API key client ID. Leave empty to use the XRAY_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

xray_client_secret.title: Xray client secret
xray_client_secret.description: Xray Cloud API key client secret. Leave empty to use the XRAY_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable.

xray_region.title: Xray region
xray_region.description: Xray Cloud region: global, eu or au. Leave empty to use the XRAY_REGION environment variable (default global).

settings_file.title: Settings file
settings_file.description: Optional explicit path to the Xray settings file (YAML or JSON) listing projects and fields.

jira_site_url.title: Jira site URL
jira_site_url.description: Optional, enables Jira tools. Example: https://yourcompany.atlassian.net

jira_email.title: Jira email
jira_email.description: Optional, email of the Jira account used for Jira tools.

jira_api_token.title: Jira API token
jira_api_token.description: Optional, Jira API token that enables Jira tools.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: When true, every write tool refuses to run. Leave empty to use the XRAY_READ_ONLY environment variable (default false).
